A '''clone trooper captain''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], working with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to repel a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Attack on Bandomeer|attack]] on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]].
